description: Ministry of Water Supply - Construction of Dunukewatta Water Tower of Kururegala North City Water Supply Project, Gorakaela Water Tower of Kurunegala North City Water Supply Project, Rambadagalla Ground Water Reservoir of Kurunegala North City Water Supply Project
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters. It contains three separate orders under the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act approving the acquisition of specific land parcels for water supply infrastructure projects. Each order includes detailed descriptions of the land properties, boundaries, locations, and claimants' information. While a government minister is named, the core content focuses on land acquisition rather than government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4).
